# opnsense_firewall_nat_settings (Resource)

Manages the global OPNsense outbound Source NAT generation mode. This is a singleton resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_firewall_nat_settings" "example" {
  mode = "hybrid"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) Outbound Source NAT generation mode: `automatic`, `hybrid`, `advanced` (manual), or `disabled`. Use `hybrid` when Terraform manages explicit NO-NAT rules while retaining automatic rules for other networks.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier `firewall_nat_settings`.
